name: maddi-mcp
description: Modification and immutability analysis of Java and Kotlin projects: what each method modifies, which types are immutable, and which contracts the code breaks.
long_description:
maddi analyses a whole Java or Kotlin project in one go: which methods modify their object or the arguments they are given, which fields are modified after construction, how far each type gets towards immutable, and where the code breaks the contracts written on it (@Immutable, @Container, @NotModified, ...). Each verdict comes with the statements behind it. An agent can analyse the project, ask why a type is not immutable or what a method modifies, and after an edit compare the verdicts before and after.

maddi runs on a JDK 25 or later, which this bundle does not include: point it at one when you install. Analyse compiled projects: sources resolve against class files.

tools.name: configure_project
tools.description: Configure a project to analyse, from its build directory or a written input configuration; stored across restarts.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The configured projects, their source sets, whether their build files still match, and their last run.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Start an analysis of a project, or of some of its source sets; returns a run id at once.

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: The state and progress of a run; can wait until it ends.

tools.name: stop_run
tools.description: Stop a run; what it streamed so far stays queryable.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: A project, package or type in one answer: types by immutability level, modifying methods, modified fields, findings.

tools.name: verdicts
tools.description: The analyzer's annotations on methods, fields, parameters and types.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: One element in full: its annotations, the properties behind them, and the statements that decide them.

tools.name: element_at
tools.description: The element at a position in a source file, explained in full.

tools.name: diff_runs
tools.description: What changed between two runs: annotations added and removed, findings new and gone.

tools.name: findings
tools.description: Contract violations, near misses and parse problems, with their why-chains.

tools.name: library_annotations
tools.description: What the analysis knows of library types (JDK, jars), and where it comes from.

jdk_home.title: JDK 25 or later
jdk_home.description: The home directory of a JDK 25 or later, which runs maddi. On macOS, for example /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-25.jdk/Contents/Home; with Homebrew, $(brew --prefix openjdk@25)/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home.

daemon_xmx_mb.title: Analysis heap (MB)
daemon_xmx_mb.description: The maximum heap of the analysis, in megabytes, for example 8192 for a large project. Empty: the JVM's default.

incremental.title: Incremental re-analysis (experimental)
incremental.description: After an edit, re-analyse only the changed types and those that depend on them, on what the previous run left. Such a result is best available, never certified; analyze with cold makes a full run.
